WSP-02 changes only dependencies_digest() to embed release/repository-Cargo.lock. handoff check proves that snapshot equals the repository runtime Cargo.lock; packaged Cargo.lock normalization is recorded separately. No supervisor logic, waiting exception, operations, bounds or authority changes. This exact source update is submitted for qualifying review with WSP-02.
